note: Previously probed AI-authored cases, not an independent test set. No model predictions or scenario tags are shown. Chinese text is an AI reading aid.

items.state: The approved refund has not appeared in my bank account after ten business days.
items.reading_aid_zh: 已获批准的退款，十个工作日后仍未到我的银行账户。

items.state: After signing in, the web dashboard stays blank in both browsers. Clearing the cache did not help.
items.reading_aid_zh: 登录后，网页仪表盘在两个浏览器中都一直空白，清除缓存也无效。

items.state: Only one of the three boxes in this shipment arrived. Where are the other two boxes?
items.reading_aid_zh: 这批货共三箱，但我只收到一箱，另外两箱在哪里？

items.state: I need a VAT invoice for the subscription payment I made yesterday.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我需要昨天订阅付款的增值税发票。

items.state: I cancelled my subscription last month, but another monthly fee appeared on my card today.
items.reading_aid_zh: 上个月已取消订阅，但今天银行卡又被收了一笔月费。

items.state: The Android app closes immediately whenever I open the settings screen.
items.reading_aid_zh: 每次打开设置页面，安卓应用都会立刻关闭。

items.state: Every password reset link says it has expired, even when I open it immediately.
items.reading_aid_zh: 每条密码重置链接都提示过期，即使我收到后马上打开。

items.state: My API requests return HTTP 401 even though I am using the new access token.
items.reading_aid_zh: 虽然使用了新访问令牌，API 请求仍返回 HTTP 401。

items.state: Tracking says my package was delivered to reception, but reception has not received it.
items.reading_aid_zh: 物流显示包裹已交给前台，但前台没有收到。

items.state: The parcel arrived soaking wet and the product inside was broken.
items.reading_aid_zh: 包裹送到时已经湿透，里面的商品也坏了。

items.state: My shipment has stayed at the same sorting centre for six days. Can someone locate it?
items.reading_aid_zh: 货物在同一个分拣中心停了六天，能帮忙查找吗？

items.state: It failed again. Can somebody sort this out?
items.reading_aid_zh: 又失败了，有人能帮忙处理吗？

items.state: I need to change it before tomorrow. Please help.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我需要在明天之前修改它，请帮忙。

items.state: A charge I do not recognise appeared on my card, and I cannot sign in to inspect my account. Both issues need fixing.
items.reading_aid_zh: 银行卡出现一笔不认识的扣款，而且我无法登录账号查看。这两个问题都需要解决。

items.state: The receipt lists the wrong company name and tax number. Please issue a corrected invoice.
items.reading_aid_zh: 收据上的公司名称和税号不正确，请重新开一张正确的发票。

items.state: My annual renewal was advertised at 80 dollars, but the renewal payment was 120 dollars.
items.reading_aid_zh: 年度续费宣传价是 80 美元，但实际续费收了 120 美元。

items.state: The payment page said the transaction was declined, yet there is a pending charge on my bank statement.
items.reading_aid_zh: 付款页面显示交易被拒绝，但银行账单上出现了一笔待处理扣款。

items.state: File uploads always stop at 67 percent and display an unexpected error.
items.reading_aid_zh: 文件上传总是在 67% 停止，并显示意外错误。

items.state: The account rejects every two-factor authentication code although my phone clock is correct.
items.reading_aid_zh: 手机时间正确，但账号仍拒绝所有双重验证代码。

items.state: The courier took my parcel to a different building. The delivery photo is not my doorway.
items.reading_aid_zh: 快递员把包裹送到了另一栋楼，投递照片不是我家门口。

items.state: There has been no tracking update for two weeks and the expected arrival date has passed.
items.reading_aid_zh: 物流两周没有更新，预计到达日期也已过去。

items.state: Can you update my details? They are no longer correct.
items.reading_aid_zh: 能帮我更新一下个人信息吗？现在的信息已经不对了。

items.state: I cannot complete this order and do not know what is wrong.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我无法完成这个订单，也不知道哪里出了问题。

items.state: My parcel was damaged in transit and my card shows two charges. Please address both problems.
items.reading_aid_zh: 包裹在运输途中损坏了，银行卡上还出现了两笔扣款。这两个问题都请处理。
